form.label: Fraud & Disputes
form.description: Fraud alerts, card blocks and chargeback lifecycle from the risk service (sourcetypes pos:fraud, pos:dispute)

search.query: sourcetype="pos:fraud" event_type="fraud.alert.created" | spath | dedup alert_id | stats count
sourcetype="pos:fraud" event_type="fraud.alert.created" severity="critical" | dedup alert_id | stats count

sourcetype="pos:fraud" event_type="fraud.alert.reviewed" | dedup alert_id | stats count(eval(status="CONFIRMED_FRAUD")) as confirmed count as reviewed | eval rate=if(reviewed=0,0,round(confirmed/reviewed*100,1)) | fields rate
sourcetype="pos:dispute" action="file_chargeback" | dedup dispute_id | stats sum(dispute_amount) as amt | eval amt=round(coalesce(amt,0),2)
sourcetype="pos:fraud" event_type="fraud.alert.created" | dedup alert_id | timechart span=5m count by rule_id

sourcetype="pos:fraud" event_type="fraud.alert.*" | dedup alert_id sortby -_time | stats count as alerts count(eval(status="CONFIRMED_FRAUD")) as confirmed count(eval(status="FALSE_POSITIVE")) as false_positive count(eval(status="OPEN")) as open by rule_id | eval precision_pct=if(confirmed+false_positive=0,"",round(confirmed/(confirmed+false_positive)*100,1))
sourcetype="pos:dispute" | dedup dispute_id sortby -_time | stats count by to_state
sourcetype="pos:dispute" to_state="CLOSED_*" | dedup dispute_id | stats count as disputes sum(dispute_amount) as amount by network to_state liability | eval amount=round(amount,2) | sort network
sourcetype="pos:fraud" event_type IN ("card.blocked","card.unblocked") | table _time event_type card_masked reason source released_by | sort - _time | head 25
sourcetype="pos:dispute" | table _time dispute_id network reason_code action from_state to_state actor dispute_amount note | sort - _time | head 50
